# Full eval pipeline for adaptive_fromscratch_seed42

echo "=== Step 1: In-dist PPL (FineWeb holdout) ==="

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python eval_ppl_ood.py \
  --model_path ${MODEL_PATH} \
  --eval_sets holdout:data/human/eval_holdout.jsonl \
  --max_docs 5000 \
  --max_length 2048 \
  --output_path ${EVAL_DIR}/ppl_holdout.json
echo "Holdout PPL done at $(date)"
cat ${EVAL_DIR}/ppl_holdout.json

echo ""
echo "=== Step 2: OOD PPL (parallel on GPU 0 and 1) ==="

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python eval_ppl_ood.py \
  --model_path ${MODEL_PATH} \
  --eval_sets openwebtext:data/eval_openwebtext.jsonl \
  --max_docs 5000 \
  --max_length 2048 \
  --output_path ${EVAL_DIR}/ppl_openwebtext.json &
PID_OWT=$!

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 python eval_ppl_ood.py \
  --model_path ${MODEL_PATH} \
  --eval_sets wikipedia:data/eval_wikipedia.jsonl \
  --max_docs 5000 \
  --max_length 2048 \
  --output_path ${EVAL_DIR}/ppl_wikipedia.json &
PID_WIKI=$!

wait $PID_OWT
echo "OpenWebText PPL done"
cat ${EVAL_DIR}/ppl_openwebtext.json

wait $PID_WIKI
echo "Wikipedia PPL done"
cat ${EVAL_DIR}/ppl_wikipedia.json

echo ""
echo "=== Step 3: Downstream benchmarks (lm-eval-harness) ==="

  --output_path ${EVAL_DIR}/downstream.json \
  --log_samples
echo "Downstream eval done at $(date)"

echo ""
echo "=== ALL EVAL COMPLETE ==="

docs/paper/sections/conclusion.tex:3:The adaptive framework's practical contribution is replacing per-model $b$ grid search with a single default $\tau$, though the effect size is modest ($\Delta{=}{-}0.043$ at $\rho{=}0.4$) and absent at 1.7B ($\Delta{=}{-}0.01$, 2 seeds).
